Sunday Light Meter Open source on GitHub

A light meter for your Opple Light Master, in the browser.

Connect a Light Master 3 or 4 over Bluetooth and read lux, colour temperature, Duv, tint and colour rendering live - then log readings and export them as CSV. No app, no account, nothing leaves your browser.

Why this exists

We are Sunday, a small team in London building a lamp that brings real daylight indoors. We use Light Masters on the bench every day, wanted the readings on a laptop without the phone app, and could not find a browser tool that supported the Light Master 4 - so we built one and open-sourced it. It uses the calibration stored in your meter and the same colour maths as the Opple app.

Curious what a light that reaches 10,000 lux at your desk looks like? Have a look at the Sunday light.
